title: pipeline_synthesis
description: Pipeline synthesis run record — emitted by lib/pipeline_synthesizer.py (Phase 5). Captures which base pipeline was matched, with what score, in which mode, where the draft YAML landed in _staging/, and which video_analysis artifact sourced it.

base_pipeline.description: Slug of the base pipeline matched (must be one of the 12 existing pipelines in pipeline_defs/ at synthesis time).

match_score.description: Rule-based match score in [0, 1]. 1.0 = perfect match; 0 = no match.

mode.description: template = generalizable adaptation; replica = closer reproduction of exact reference (per SYNTH-04).

staging_path.description: Absolute or repo-relative path under pipeline_defs/_staging/<slug>.yaml. Never points into pipeline_defs/ directly (per SYNTH-05).

diff_against_base.description: Free-form diff text (unified-diff or human-readable) showing what the synthesized YAML changed vs the base pipeline.

validation_status.description: Result of semantic validation — every skill: path exists, every tool appears in the registry (per SYNTH-08).

source_analysis_checksum.description: Content hash (e.g., sha256 hex) of the video_analysis artifact that sourced this synthesis. Used for idempotency (SYNTH-06).

provider_used.description: Analysis provider whose video_analysis artifact fed this synthesis.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the synthesis run (optional; producer may set).
